records.issue_text: group.users.count plus group.users.order(...).limit(...) executes two queries; count on large groups can be slow with no caching
records.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff introduces `total = group.users.count` followed by a separate `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)` query. This will execute two DB queries per request, and `count` on large groups can be expensive. It’s a concrete performance concern visible in the diff, not a functional correctness bug.
